annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidelines are addressed to relevant authorities (coastal State, flag State, port State) and relevant stakeholders such as shipowners/authorized representatives, operators and other involved parties in MASS trials; they are non-binding, with Member States invited to use them.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: These Guidelines provide guidance to: .1 relevant authorities: .1 coastal State; .2 flag State; and .3 port State; and .2 relevant stakeholders such as shipowners/authorized representatives, operators and other involved parties
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Interim Guidelines for MASS trials, as set out in the annex.
